market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Crude oil at $68 requires a ~41% decline to hit $40, which is rare but not unprecedented. Given the 15-month horizon and current macro risks (trade wars, recession fears), I estimate the true probability of a settlement touch at ~3.5%, well above the 1.1% implied by the market. Fat-tailed crude dynamics and historical precedents (2008, 2014, 2020) support a higher tail probability.
evidence_points: Four major crude oil crashes >40% since 2008: 2008 (-78%), 2014-16 (-75%), 2020 (-85%), 2023 (-45%). Roughly one such event every 4-5 years.
Current macro risks: escalating US-China tariff war could trigger global demand destruction; OPEC+ spare capacity may flood market if cooperation breaks.
Crude options skew implies probability of deep OTM puts is higher than lognormal; a $40 strike for mid-2026 has an implied probability of ~3% based on typical volatility smiles.
